item.title: This Excuse Doesn’t Cut It
item.description: Read This Excuse Doesn’t Cut It Boss: "[Coworker], why are you over an hour late?" Coworker: "Sorry, my son got a bad haircut, and I had to fix it before I came in." Boss: "You couldn't have called to tell us?" Read This Excuse Doesn’t Cut It

item.title: All Money, No Manners
item.description: Read All Money, No Manners Customer: "Hey! You need to serve me first!" Me: "I’ll be right with you, sir. He was next." Customer: "You need to serve me first! I spend way more money here than this guy does!" Read All Money, No Manners

item.title: They Know How To Drive A U Turn
item.description: Read They Know How To Drive A U Turn Me: "Boss, I'm sorry, but the new schedule doesn't work for me. I requested tomorrow off for my driving exam, and it was approved weeks ago." Boss: "Well, I wasn't told. You need to let me know these things in advance. I have plans with my boyfriend tomorrow that I can't cancel." Read They Know How To Drive A U Turn

item.title: No Soup For You! Part 14
item.description: Read No Soup For You! Part 14 I work at an ice cream store. Everything about the place, from the name, color scheme, pictures on the wall, and the selection of food at the counter, indicates that we are solely an ice cream store. We don't even sell drinks. Customer: *After looking at the menu for a few seconds.* "What kinds of soups do you have?" Read No Soup For You! Part 14

item.title: Self-Sustaining Stupidity
item.description: Read Self-Sustaining Stupidity Me: "So the computer isn't powering on at all?" Caller: "No!" Me: "Is it plugged into an outlet?" Caller: "Kinda." Read Self-Sustaining Stupidity
